description: Replacement of existing single glazed timber framed sash windows to the front elevation with double glazed timber framed sash windows and the existing single glazed rear elevations with new double glazed timber sash windows; and replacement of existing single glazed timber framed basement entrance door to the rear elevation with a new double glazed composite GRP door.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the following approved drawings; other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

26-010 002 06 - received 24/08/2026;   
FSW-009 - received 24/08/2026; 
26-010 002 05 - received 24/08/2026 

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

Windows: Front elevation - Double glazed sash timber windows with details including the arched head, colours, opening mechanism, glazing configuration, and run through sash horns to match the existing/original windows to be replaced.  

Windows: Rear elevation - Double glazed sash and casement timber windows. Sash details including the run through sash horns, opening mechanism, glazing configuration to match the existing windows to be replaced.  

Door: Basement front � double-glazed composite grp 

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC6 of the Local Plan (2018).

phasing_details.phase_detail: Windows, Balcony Doors and Flat Roof
